comment: Architecture: V1 Ch8 (STT / Transcript); V4 Ch5 (PII Redaction); V5 Ch5 (Analytics). Call transcripts store the full turn-by-turn conversation with word-level timestamps. PII is redacted at write time (PIIRedacted event). TTL enforces the retention policy (V4 Ch11.3).

options.comment: Sparse: only indexes documents that have a campaign_id field.
TTL retention: transcript expires_at = call date + retention_days (per tenant config).
